rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: move reuses the booking rules from Rules (withinBookingHorizon, DEC-C01; slotFree, DEC-C02) against the appointment's own clinician, and returns the same ClinicError values as book, so a refused move prints the same error and leaves the state unchanged.
reasons: A2 'docs/architecture.md' does not resolve to a requirement, decision record or approval

decisions.statement: The slot check is run against the current state without excluding the appointment being moved, because the requirement says a move is refused whenever a new booking at that date and time would be refused. A move to the appointment's own current date and time is therefore refused as SlotTaken (unless the rule's existing k2 case applies). This is recorded as an open question.

The move date and time are parsed with the same parsers as book (yyyy-MM-dd, HH:mm) before the appointment is looked up, matching book's order of checks. A wrong number of arguments prints the usage line through the existing usage mechanism.
Added 'move <appointment> <date> <time>' to Cli.usage directly after 'cancel <appointment>' and to the README command list in the same position.

The existing hard-coded exception in Rules.slotFree (clinician k2's slots never count as taken) was left as it is, and move inherits it by reusing the rule. No decision record or approval in docs/ supports it, and DEC-C02 makes no exception. I neither changed it nor extended it, and it is raised as an open question.
